items: A restaurant chatbot answers guests instantly across every location, which gets harder to do by hand as you grow into a multi-location business or franchise.
Match the chatbot to where your guests reach you: your website, Instagram and Messenger, phone calls, or review sites and delivery apps.
Automate common questions about hours, menus and reservations, and make sure the bot hands off to a team member with full context when a guest needs a person.
Connections to your reservation, loyalty and POS systems let a chatbot book tables, recognize high-value guests and issue recovery offers inside the conversation.
Momos uses its AI agent Alfie to reply to reviews and guest messages within minutes in your brand voice, escalate when needed and track whether upset guests return.
